### E1-6 – Gross Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3 and total GHG emissions

In 2021, Banco BPM measured greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions associated with its own operations and other indirect activities. Scope 2 emissions were reported for the consolidated accounting group under the financial-control approach; the figures for own operations and the consolidated accounting group were identical.

| GHG emissions | 2021 (tCO₂e) |
|---|---:|
| Scope 1 emissions covered by the internal carbon pricing scheme | 12,360 |
| Scope 2 – location-based | 35,103 |
| Scope 2 – market-based | 4,638 |
| Scope 3 – other indirect emissions category | 14,598 |
| **Total Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 – location-based** | **62,061** |
| **Total Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 – market-based** | **31,596** |

The reported Scope 1 figure of 12,360 tCO₂e represents the approximate volume of Scope 1 emissions covered by Banco BPM’s internal carbon fee or fund. The available 2021 information does not identify a separate Scope 1 total outside the coverage of that mechanism. Scope 2 emissions amounted to 35,103 tCO₂e under the location-based method and 4,638 tCO₂e under the market-based method. The difference between the two approaches reflects the respective treatment of purchased energy. The market-based Scope 2 amount was also reported as the Bank’s market-based GHG emissions indicator.

Gross Scope 3 emissions reported within the “other Scope 3 greenhouse gas emissions” category totalled 14,598 tCO₂e. The available reporting information does not provide a further breakdown by Scope 3 category for 2021. Accordingly, the totals presented above are calculated by adding the disclosed Scope 1 amount, the relevant Scope 2 measure and reported Scope 3 emissions; they should be interpreted in light of the stated Scope 1 coverage and Scope 3 categorisation.

For context, in 2020 Banco BPM reported Scope 1 emissions of 10,465 tCO₂e and location-based Scope 2 emissions of 33,239 tCO₂e. Scope 3 emissions associated with purchased paper were 1,986 tCO₂e, while business travel generated 166 tCO₂e. The 2021 Scope 3 figure is broader in reported value but is not accompanied by sufficient category detail to establish like-for-like comparability. No specific 2021 GHG reduction target, base year or additional emissions-governance arrangement is identified in the information available for this disclosure.

### E1-6 – Gross Scope 1, Scope 2, Scope 3 and total GHG emissions

In 2021, Banco BPM measured greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions associated with its own operations and other indirect activities. Scope 2 emissions were reported for the consolidated accounting group under the financial-control approach; the figures for own operations and the consolidated accounting group were identical.

| GHG emissions | 2021 (tCO₂e) |
|---|---:|
| Scope 1 emissions covered by the internal carbon pricing scheme | 12,360 |
| Scope 2 – location-based | 35,103 |
| Scope 2 – market-based | 4,638 |
| Scope 3 – other indirect emissions category | 14,598 |
| **Total Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 – location-based** | **62,061** |
| **Total Scope 1, Scope 2 and Scope 3 – market-based** | **31,596** |

The reported Scope 1 figure of 12,360 tCO₂e represents the approximate volume of Scope 1 emissions covered by Banco BPM’s internal carbon fee or fund. The available 2021 information does not identify a separate Scope 1 total outside the coverage of that mechanism. Scope 2 emissions amounted to 35,103 tCO₂e under the location-based method and 4,638 tCO₂e under the market-based method. The difference between the two approaches reflects the respective treatment of purchased energy. The market-based Scope 2 amount was also reported as the Bank’s market-based GHG emissions indicator.

Gross Scope 3 emissions reported within the “other Scope 3 greenhouse gas emissions” category totalled 14,598 tCO₂e. The available reporting information does not provide a further breakdown by Scope 3 category for 2021. Accordingly, the totals presented above are calculated by adding the disclosed Scope 1 amount, the relevant Scope 2 measure and reported Scope 3 emissions; they should be interpreted in light of the stated Scope 1 coverage and Scope 3 categorisation.

For context, in 2020 Banco BPM reported Scope 1 emissions of 10,465 tCO₂e and location-based Scope 2 emissions of 33,239 tCO₂e. Scope 3 emissions associated with purchased paper were 1,986 tCO₂e, while business travel generated 166 tCO₂e. The 2021 Scope 3 figure is broader in reported value but is not accompanied by sufficient category detail to establish like-for-like comparability. No specific 2021 GHG reduction target, base year or additional emissions-governance arrangement is identified in the information available for this disclosure.
